research_rationale: Blocked. Whether the Code of Fair Competition for the Iron and Steel Industry approved by this order on August 19, 1933 ended before the June 14, 1935 repeal is not established by held evidence. The held text of EO 6730 (May 30, 1934; SUPPLEMENT:EO6730) approves "certain amendments to the Code of Fair Competition of the Iron and Steel Industry as approved on August 19, 1933" and then "said Code as amended", "said revised Code incorporating said amendments to become effective on June 11, 1934, prior to which effective date the Code of Fair Competition approved August 19, 1933, shall continue in full force and effect". It does not say that the August 19, 1933 approval ceased on June 11, 1934, nor that it continued after that date as the amended code, and it neither revokes nor cancels the 1933 approval. The reviewed shared analysis leaves open whether a revised-code approval supersedes or merely amends an earlier approval. If EO 6730 superseded the 1933 code, the first end is June 11, 1934 (the 1933 code was in force only before that date); if it only amended it, the first end is the June 14, 1935 repeal. No held source (the code text, its Article XII, or an NRA release) decides between them, so neither date is claimed.
